scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.build:apk: npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk} ./android/gradlew -p android assembleRelease -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ./brewspace.apk
scripts.format: prettier --write app src tests e2e *.json *.ts *.mts *.js README.md CONTRIBUTING.md docs/core.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check app src tests e2e *.json *.ts *.mts *.js README.md CONTRIBUTING.md docs/core.md
